messages:
samir: Heads-up: payments.partition migration targeted tonight. Need a short dual-write window and someone to own the deploy + rollback readiness. Who can take deploy?

eva: I can coordinate the deploy. proposing 02:00-03:00 UTC (lowest traffic). dual-write for writes only, reads stay on primary for 10m then verify.

aleine: I'll run the backfill jobs post-deploy. ETA for backfill = ~45m for current shard sizes; I can parallelize if we have extra capacity.

niko: Quick checklist request: can we get preflight smoke steps and exact rollback steps in thread? I want to run them during the window.

samir: Preflight (to run ~30m before):
- ensure replica lag < 3s
- run schema-lint and db-consistency-check
- export small sample counts for payments by shard

Example commands:
```
# replica lag
psql -c "select now()-pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp() as lag"
# sample count
psql -c "select count(*) from payments where created_at > now() - interval '1 day'"
```

eva: Deploy plan (02:00 UTC):
1) put feature-flag payments_partition.write -> on for app (dual-write)
2) deploy migration job (rolling) via k8s job to apply schema (no exclusive locks)
3) monitor error rate + DB slow queries for 10m
4) start backfill worker (alaine)

Rollback plan (if >=1% error rate or replica lag > 10s):
- toggle feature-flag payments_partition.write -> off (stops writes to new schema)
- scale down backfill workers: kubectl scale deployment/payments-backfill --replicas=0 -n prod
- redeploy app to previous tag if app-level incompat required: kubectl set image deployment/payments-app payments-app=redwood/payments:stable -n prod
- open a rollback incident channel and escalate oncall

aleine: Backfill specifics: I will run with concurrency=8 by default; if we see write amplification issues drop to 2. I'll post progress every 5m: counts processed / total / ETA.

deploy-bot: scheduled deployment: payments-partition-migration at 1766013200 (02:00 UTC). Trigger: manual confirm in thread.

niko: I will take smoke checks at +5m and +15m post-deploy: verify 200s success rate for payments endpoints, sample lookups from both old and new tables return identical results for 100 random ids. I'll post scripts in #eng-test.

samir: Thanks — eva you'll be primary deployer, alaine backfill lead, niko smoke checks, I'm oncall for rollback. @deploy-bot leave the manual trigger; eva please confirm you will flip the feature flag and push the deployment at 02:00. :thumbsup:

eva: Confirmed. I'll trigger at 02:00 and update thread at each step. If anything looks off I'll hit rollback plan and ping oncall.

samir: Great. Leaving the post-deploy checklist here so we don't forget:
- post-deploy perf dashboard: payments.latency, db.qps, replica_lag
- run integrity spot-check query set (niko)
- handoff when backfill finishes (alaine)
- close change ticket and record metrics

niko: Copy. Will prepare the spot-check script and post link before 01:30 UTC.

eva: One more: I'll add a short deploy notice to #general 30m before so CS knows about transient errors.

samir: Perfect. Thanks everyone.
